import importlib.util, re as _re

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("textmask", "/work/textmask.py")
tm = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(tm)

# reference (original) implementation for comparison
def orig_masked(text, name):
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in sorted({name} | set(name.split("-")), key=len, reverse=True):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = _re.sub(r"\b" + _re.escape(tok) + r"\b", "x", t)
    return t

cases = [
    ("Fowler Refactoring skill", "fowler-refactoring"),
    ("ab AB abc ABC", "abc-ab"),
    ("", "a-b-c"),
    ("The Quick Brown Fox", "quick-fox-brown"),
    ("CaseSensitive CASESENSITIVE casesensitive", "CaseSensitive"),
    ("no-matches-here", "zzz-yyy"),
    ("x", "x"),
]

all_ok = True
for text, name in cases:
    got = tm.masked(text, name)
    exp = orig_masked(text, name)
    ok = got == exp
    all_ok &= ok
    print(repr(text), repr(name), "->", repr(got), "expected", repr(exp), "OK" if ok else "MISMATCH")

print("name_tokens check:", tm.name_tokens("fowler-refactoring-skill"))
print("ALL OK" if all_ok else "FAILURES PRESENT")

# check file contents only have re import + two functions
src = open('/work/textmask.py').read()
print("---")
print("only re import:", src.count("import") , [l for l in src.splitlines() if "import" in l])
print("def count:", src.count("def "))
